established_facts: The camera wearer began by retrieving a glass from the sink and placing it on the counter, then opened and closed the fridge while walking toward the kitchen counter. Next, the camera wearer picked up a pan from the cooker, placed it back, and then picked up meat from the counter and placed it into the pan on the cooker. The camera wearer then picked up a pan with sausages, placed it on the cooker, and stirred the food with a wooden spoon. The camera wearer also picked up an egg from the egg tray and manipulated pans on the stove and counter. The camera wearer retrieved two plates from the cabinet and placed them on the counter. The camera wearer then looked around the kitchen, picked up a knife, opened and closed a cabinet, and walked around the kitchen while looking at the sink. Later, the camera wearer interacted with Man X, who picked up a glass of juice, a fork, and engaged in repetitive actions of stirring food with a spoon. The camera wearer also poured juice into a glass, opened the fridge, and later picked up a plate, poured water into a cup, and washed a sponge with water from the tap.
